request.description:
**Data-driven** — Collection Runner + `postman/data/cancel-states.csv` (cột `fromState,expectedStatus`), Iterations = 5.

Pre-request dựng 1 đơn tới đúng `{{fromState}}` (checkout → admin đẩy state) rồi request PUT cancel. Test so `pm.response.code` với `{{expectedStatus}}`.

Kỳ vọng: pending/confirmed → 200 · shipping/delivered/canceled → 400.

⚠ Dòng `shipping` → SUT trả 200 ⇒ **FAIL = BUG-05** (matrix gộp cho state-transition API-2).
